text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — Aperture Systems confirmed an onsite preview run at our SF lab next week. NDA is in place but legal wants a quick read on scope. Need shipping details and the bench plan. :ship:
Liam Chen: Legal confirmed countersigned NDA; I uploaded the PDF to the partner bucket (s3://partners/aperture/nda/countersigned.pdf).
Olivia Ruiz: Great. Can Ops confirm lab access window and customs invoice format? Also whoever's shipping, get the commercial invoice right.
Samir Rao: Logistics update — Ops is handling inbound. ETA to lab: Tue 09:00 local. Carrier: UPS, tracking 1Z999AA12345678901. I'll post updates.
Grace Kim: Ops note: power cabinets reserved (2 U slots), rack access from 07:30. Need per-node power draw and serials. Also confirm whether the partner team needs guest wifi or dedicated jumpbox.
Maya Patel: Serial numbers are AP-2201-01 and AP-2201-02. Power expected ~850W per node at peak for our load. Partner team will use our jumpbox with scoped creds. Legal allowed limited telemetry collection.
Liam Chen: Security: no USB drop allowed. Use secure upload only. I'll request short-lived SFTP creds from infra. Also add a step to scrub any partner PII from logs before we upload to shared buckets.
Olivia Ruiz: Bench plan (high level): perf sweep, memory stress, throughput vs latency matrix, and a quick qualitative generation regression set. Owner list: Samir runs infra/throughput, Olivia runs quality evals, Grace collects infra notes. Example run command for the ops runbook:
```
rbench --model gpt-slim --seq 2048 --batch 4 --iters 100 \ 
  --telemetry-url https://telemetry.redwood.ai/hw-preview \ 
  --out /tmp/aperture-bench.log
```
Samir Rao: I'll build the container image `redwood/preview-aperture:2026-03` and load the runbook onto the jumpbox. Will also attach a script to sanitize logs: `scripts/scrub_logs.sh`.
Grace Kim: Ops: we've created secure path `/mnt/partners/aperture/1768459999`. Need SFTP creds and a cleanup TTL. @Liam please ask infra for 48h creds.
Liam Chen: Request submitted to infra; they said creds will be created and rotated automatically for 48h. I'll post when ready.
Olivia Ruiz: Quality note: if we detect >2% regression on the eval prompt set switch to the fallback fp16 model and stop the run. Add that to the runbook.
Maya Patel: Good catch. Product wants a one-page feedback template for the partner meeting. Olivia, can you own that? Grace, add infra checklist.
Olivia Ruiz: Yup — I'll draft the feedback template and attach sample metrics (latency p50/p95, throughput, generation BLEU-ish scores) before the run.
Samir Rao: Customs remark from Aperture: label as 'Commercial sample' with declared value for temporary import. Legal confirmed this is fine; return label included.
Liam Chen: Legal also reminded: redact any customer prompts from logs. Add `--redact-customer-data` to run args where applicable.
Maya Patel: Travel/people: Samir + Olivia can go onsite. Grace will be remote standby and handle infra notes. @Samir please confirm flight itinerary by EOD. :airplane:
Samir Rao: Confirmed — I'll book and drop itinerary here tonight.
deploy-bot: Reminder: SF lab booking approved for 2026-04-02 08:00-18:00.
Grace Kim: Ops final: I've reserved a spare ethernet patch, UPS on-site, and a small cold-water fan. Anything else?
Olivia Ruiz: I'll bring the eval prompt set and a clean laptop image. Samir — please ensure the container has `rbench` v1.4 and the telemetry shim.
Samir Rao: Will do. Upload path for post-run artifacts: s3://partners/aperture/runs/1768459999/. Please keep naming consistent: `run-<node>-YYYYMMDD.tar.gz`.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. Action items: Liam (creds + redact flag), Samir (container + travel + upload), Olivia (feedback template + evals), Grace (infra checklist). We'll sync in a brief huddle tomorrow 10:00 to confirm final logistics. :thumbsup:
